findings.finding: The prefetch revenue history is not SoFi's revenue. Every pf_revenue_* fact comes from the XBRL tag RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (ASC 606 fee revenue only; companyfacts: FY2025 619,353k, Q2 2026 153,577k). SoFi's total net revenue for FY2025 is 3,613,354k (sum of the quarterly totals 771,759 + 854,944 + 961,600 + 1,025,051 in the Q3 2026 and Q4 2025 releases; adjusted 3,591,411k). These values feed prefetch/history.json and understand/auto.json history: FY2020-FY2025 revenue 103M to 619M, operating margin 115.8% in FY2023, FCF margin -1,741% in FY2023, the computed type 'revenue compounding at 20% or more' and Piotroski 2/6. Against guided FY2026 adjusted net revenue of 5.04bn, the base year is understated about 5.8x. A growth path or margin taken from this history is wrong by an order of magnitude.
findings.where: gather/_prefetch.json facts pf_revenue_fy2020..pf_revenue_fy2025 and pf_revenue_q_* (e.g. pf_revenue_fy2025, pf_revenue_q_2026_06_30); propagated to prefetch/history.json and understand/auto.json history / computed_type / forensic
findings.fix: Repair: add a cleaned total-net-revenue series (metric revenue, basis reported, GAAP total net revenue) for FY2021-FY2025 and the 2025-2026 quarters from the SoFi releases (pf_rel_*, 10-K pf_10k_20260217), e.g. FY2025 3,613,354k and Q3 2026 1,385,099k. Make the engine's history and the current_year_revenue / growth drivers use it, never pf_revenue_*. State the basis switch in notes: guidance is ADJUSTED net revenue (FY2025 adjusted 3,591,411k gives 5.04bn/3.591bn = +40.3%, matching the release's ~40%). Re-read computed_type and forensic on the corrected series, or mark them not applicable to a bank holding company.

findings.finding: pf_operating_income_* is not an operating income. FY2025 525,857k is pre-tax income (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxes...). The basis 'derived' series gives FY2023 +488,169k although SoFi had a pre-tax and net loss in 2023 (net margin -71% in the same history row). The operating margins that history.json / auto.json derive from it are meaningless for this lender.
findings.fix: Repair: do not use pf_operating_income_* for SOFI. For a bank holding company, use pre-tax income / net income from the releases or 10-K, with net revenue on the same basis. Mark the FY2020-FY2024 operating margins as a gap rather than letting any driver read them.

findings.finding: The guidance track record cannot be used by the engine, and the lane's ratio is overstated. All guidance_track rows use metric 'adjusted_net_revenue' / 'adjusted_ebitda'. evidence_pack.track_record counts only metric 'revenue' (or no metric), so ticker-check prints track_record null, and any adjust_by_track_record=true is rejected. On the four revenue rows the mean actual/guided is (858.23/795 + 3591.411/3237.5 + 1087.232/1040 + 1205.55/1115.7)/4 = (1.0796 + 1.1093 + 1.0454 + 1.0805)/4 = 1.079, not the 'about 1.10' in the numbers note.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json guidance_track (all rows) and notes 'nm TRACK RECORD'
findings.fix: Repair: set metric 'revenue' on the four adjusted-net-revenue rows; keep the EBITDA rows as non-revenue metrics. Correct the note to a mean ratio of about 1.08 (4 beats, 0 misses). State that the basis is adjusted net revenue, the same basis as the FY2026 guidance.

findings.finding: The FY2025 track row cites the wrong guiding release. guided_mid 3,237.5M is the midpoint of the 27 Jan 2025 range of 3.200-3.275bn (release_2025-01-27, line 326), but source_ids names pf_rel_20250429_1. That release raised the range to 3.235-3.310bn (midpoint 3,272.5M; ratio 1.097). Also, the Q2 2026 row's guided_mid 1,115.7M is derived (858.23M x 1.30, from 'growth of approximately 30%', release_2026-04-29 line 299), not a stated number.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json guidance_track period FY2025 / adjusted_net_revenue; period Q2 2026
findings.fix: Cite the 27 Jan 2025 release (register it if needed) for 3,237.5M, or keep pf_rel_20250429_1 and use 3,272.5M. Mark the Q2 2026 guided_mid as derived from growth guidance in a note.

findings.finding: The consensus cannot back anything yet, and it is stale. nm_av_est (kind consensus, retrieval provider_normalized) is dated 2026-11-02, so under LAG_DAYS it is not citable until 2026-11-04; ticker-trace lists it under sources_not_yet_citable. The figures also predate the Q3 print: FY2026 revenue average 4.876bn sits below the 5.04bn guidance that the release itself says was raised 'above analyst estimates', and the Q3 2026 estimate row (1.26bn) is older than the 1.385bn actual. The basis is also unknown: the provider's 'revenue' is GAAP or adjusted, and it is not stated which.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json sources nm_av_est; consensus nm_cons_rev_fy2026, nm_cons_eps_fy2026, nm_cons_rev_fy2027, nm_cons_eps_fy2027, nm_cons_rev_q4_2026, nm_cons_eps_q4_2026
findings.fix: Keep the consensus out of drivers, the expectation gap and the key risk. Show it only as a stale, not-yet-citable expectation row. Name the gap: post-Q3 attributed consensus, on a stated basis, was not collected. Do not redate the source.

findings.finding: The Q3 call transcript is the issuer's call syndicated through Alpha Vantage. It is marked independent false, but syndicated_from is null. The Q4 2026 guidance items (dc_g_rev_q4 1.375bn etc.) cite only this transcript. 1.375bn is verified in transcript.txt and agrees with 5.04bn minus 9M adjusted 3,663.906M = 1,376M.
findings.where: gather/documents.json sources dc_call_20261027; guidance dc_g_rev_q4, dc_g_ebitda_q4, dc_g_ni_q4, dc_g_eps_q4, dc_g_lend_q4, dc_g_fs_q4, dc_g_tech_q4
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from to 'SoFi Technologies Q3 2026 earnings call, 2026-10-27'. Optionally add pf_rel_20261027_1 as a second source on dc_g_rev_q4 (the remainder is implied by the release's 5.04bn and the 9M adjusted revenue).

findings.finding: The guidance labels differ from the release wording. dc_g_mem26 says 'new members growth at least 30%'; the release (line 317) says to 'increase total members by at least 30% year-over-year'. For dc_g_ni26, the highlight paragraph (line 46) says '$840.0 million of net income' while the outlook (line 316) says 'adjusted net income of approximately $840 million'. The fragment uses the adjusted basis, which is correct.
findings.fix: Relabel dc_g_mem26 as 'total members growth, at least'. Note on dc_g_ni26 that the release uses both wordings and the outlook section is on the adjusted basis.

findings.finding: The two lanes record net interest income Q3 2026 at different precision: nm_nii_q3_2026 is 929,500,000 (rounded from the $929.5 million text) and dc_f02_net_interest_income is 929,452,000 (the table value).
findings.fix: Use 929,452,000 in both, or drop nm_nii_q3_2026 as a duplicate.

findings.finding: The ERP of 4.2% (Damodaran, 2026-10-01) was computed against a 5.29% treasury, while the risk-free used is the 10y at 4.98% (2026-10-29). The pairing convention differs by 31 bp, and the ERP source is provider_normalized under kind macro.
findings.fix: Note the pairing in the valuation notes. No change to market prices of risk is required.
